note: The HUB: a curated shortlist of legitimate protocols this desk is willing to point USD at, joined live with DefiLlama's index. Curation criteria: a multi-year track record or >$1b deposited, a named team, public audits, and a way in for plain USD stablecoins — with two exceptions it is honest about: Bittensor is TAO-in and quotes no APY, and the tokenized-treasury entries (BUIDL, USYC, Ondo, parts of Centrifuge) are KYC-gated, say so in their risks, and cannot be entered from this desk. Curated does not mean safe — every entry lists its own risks next to its credentials, every live number beside it is the index's (not ours), and every card now carries an observed APR band: the lower and upper bound the record itself supports, lifetime mean ± 2σ of daily APY widened to cover today's rate.

protocols.name: Aave V3
protocols.blurb: Deposit dollars into a shared lending pool; borrowers post collateral and pay interest to you continuously. Withdraw whenever the pool has liquidity.
legit: the largest onchain lender — around $17b deposited
live since 2020 with no core-market loss of depositor funds
audited repeatedly (Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, SigmaPrime…) and backstopped by a staked safety module
risks: smart-contract risk, as everywhere
at 100% utilisation withdrawals wait until borrowers repay
rates and collateral rules are set by token governance

protocols.name: Morpho
protocols.blurb: Your USD goes into a vault run by a named curator, who lends it across isolated markets. Each vault publishes exactly which markets it touches.
legit: around $14b deposited across curated vaults
minimal immutable core, formally verified (Certora), audited by Spearbit and OpenZeppelin
curators are named and their allocations are public onchain
risks: you are trusting the curator's market picks
an isolated market can take bad debt if its oracle or collateral fails
withdrawal depends on the vault's idle liquidity

protocols.name: Sky (MakerDAO)
protocols.blurb: Swap into the savings token (sUSDS or sDAI) and it grows at the Sky Savings Rate set by governance. Unwind back to dollars instantly, any size.
legit: the oldest DeFi protocol still running — MakerDAO since 2017
around $8b earning the savings rate
the savings contract is a simple, heavily-audited ERC-4626 wrapper
risks: the rate is a governance decision and moves
the backing includes real-world assets — offchain counterparty exposure
USDS/DAI itself is the thing you are holding; its peg is the risk

protocols.name: Spark
protocols.blurb: The Sky ecosystem's lender — an Aave V3 fork seeded with Sky's own liquidity, so dollar deposit rates stay close to the savings rate with pool lending on top. Its savings side (sUSDS/sUSDC) pays the Sky Savings Rate directly.
legit: around $5b supplied
runs audited Aave V3 code, governed and backstopped by Sky
deep, stable liquidity — the ecosystem itself is the largest lender
risks: smart-contract risk of the fork plus its Sky wiring
concentrated governance — Sky can retune it quickly
utilisation can briefly pause withdrawals, as in any pool lender

protocols.name: Compound V3
protocols.blurb: Each market lends exactly one asset — you supply USDC, borrowers post other collateral against it. Simpler than a shared pool, and it reads that way onchain.
legit: lending onchain since 2018 — the protocol that invented the model
V3's one-borrowable-asset design shrinks what can go wrong
audited by OpenZeppelin and ChainSecurity, run by a veteran DAO
risks: smart-contract risk
smaller markets can sit at high utilisation
COMP reward share of the rate comes and goes

protocols.name: Maple · syrupUSDC
protocols.blurb: Your USDC is lent to vetted institutional borrowers against posted collateral, managed by Maple's credit desk. Yield comes from real borrowing demand, not emissions.
legit: around $4b managed, live since 2021
borrowers are named institutions under signed agreements, now overcollateralised
survived a real credit cycle and rebuilt — the 2022 losses reshaped its underwriting
risks: credit risk is the product: a borrower default is your loss
withdrawals can queue while loans mature
took real losses in 2022 (Orthogonal) under the old uncollateralised model

protocols.name: Fluid
protocols.blurb: Instadapp's lender: deposits earn from borrowers whose collateral is simultaneously working as DEX liquidity, so the same dollar earns twice.
legit: built by Instadapp, shipping DeFi infrastructure since 2018
over $1b deposited within its first year
audited by MixBytes and Statemind; conservative launch caps
risks: young contracts — the design is novel and less battle-tested
the shared liquidity layer couples lending to DEX flow
utilisation pauses withdrawals, as in any pool lender

protocols.name: Ethena · sUSDe
protocols.blurb: USDe is a dollar built from crypto collateral hedged with short futures; staking it earns the funding-rate spread. It is a trade wearing a stablecoin's clothes — the yield is real and so are the ways it can stop.
legit: around $1.3b staked; grew through two full funding cycles
reserves and hedges are published and attested
audited (Zellic, Quantstamp…), insurance fund absorbs negative-funding stretches
risks: funding can go negative — the yield can drop to zero or the fund can drain
exchange and custodian failure would hit the backing
7-day cooldown to unstake natively (or sell the receipt at market)

protocols.name: Kamino
protocols.blurb: Solana's main lending market — deposit dollars, earn from leverage and borrowing demand on the fastest-moving chain. Rates run hotter and swing harder than Ethereum's.
legit: the largest Solana lender — around $1.5b deposited
live through multiple Solana market cycles since 2022
audited by OtterSec and Offside Labs, open risk dashboard
risks: Solana-grade volatility — rates and liquidity move fast
oracle and liquidation risk in sharp moves
chain halts have happened on Solana before

protocols.name: Save (Solend)
protocols.blurb: Solana's original lending pool, rebranded from Solend. Smaller and quieter than Kamino — a second venue for dollar lending on Solana.
legit: lending on Solana since 2021, through every cycle since
survived the 2022 whale-liquidation and oracle incidents and paid depositors
conservative asset list after those lessons
risks: much smaller pools — around $100m, thinner exits
took a $1.3m oracle exploit in Nov 2022 (reimbursed)
the same Solana-wide risks as every venue on the chain

protocols.name: Curve
protocols.blurb: Put dollars into a stable-swap pool and earn the trading fees of everyone exchanging through it. You hold the pool's mix — if one coin in the pool depegs, part of your dollars become it.
legit: the reference venue for stablecoin swaps since 2020
battle-tested pool math with billions through it daily
fees are organic — traders pay them, no emissions needed to exist
risks: paired exposure: the weakest coin in the pool is partly yours
a 2023 reentrancy hit some non-stable pools — the risk is real
headline APYs on small pools are usually gauge emissions, not fees

protocols.name: Bittensor
protocols.blurb: Stake TAO — into root for a share of every subnet's emission, or into a subnet's dTAO pool for its alpha token. The one entry here that is not a dollar protocol: TAO goes in, and what you hold floats.
legit: the largest decentralized AI network — live since 2021, root pool alone holds millions of TAO
open-source (Opentensor), fixed 21m supply with a Bitcoin-style halving schedule
this desk reads and stakes it through the bt module directly against the chain — every number on this card is live off the bt module's open indexer (bt_screener)
risks: not USD: you carry TAO's price on top of everything else, and a subnet's alpha floats on top of TAO
no APY is promised anywhere — the return is emission on a floating price, and dTAO itself only launched in Feb 2025
a subnet's alpha can go to ~zero if its team or demand disappears, and thin pools move a lot on a single trade

protocols.name: Hyperliquid Vaults
protocols.blurb: Put USDC behind a vault leader who trades Hyperliquid perps with it; your equity is a share of the vault's account value, marked live. Withdraw after the vault's lock-up (a day for user vaults, four for HLP).
legit: Hyperliquid clears more perps volume than any other onchain venue, live since 2023
vault equity is marked on the exchange's own book — no oracle between you and your balance
leaders must keep at least 5% of their own vault, so they eat their own losses first
risks: the quoted APR is trailing realized PnL annualized — a track record, not a rate; it can be extreme and it can be negative
leaders trade with leverage; a vault can lose most or all of its equity
Hyperliquid is its own L1 — bridge, sequencer and exchange risk sit under every vault
withdrawals wait out the lock-up; there is no exit during the wait

protocols.name: Polymarket Copy-Trading
protocols.blurb: Pick a Polymarket trader and mirror them one-to-one: a live session copies each of their trades at the same fraction of your capital as it was of theirs (bankroll fidelity). Sessions start in DRY RUN and place nothing until you arm autoExecute.
legit: Polymarket is the deepest prediction market — billions in cumulative volume, USDC-settled onchain
the trader board is ranked on 30 days of real fills — PnL, win rate, resolve rate, Sharpe — not self-reported returns
the mirror runs on this fleet's own polymarket module: your keys, your session, stoppable any time and never gated on exit
risks: past PnL is not a rate — you copy the trader's NEXT trades, including their losses
copies fill after the leader at worse prices; late fills bleed edge on fast markets
positions held to resolution can expire worthless; stopping the session does not close what it already bought
this deployment is owner-only — the board and the engine open only with its access token

protocols.name: Uniswap
protocols.blurb: Provide both sides of a stablecoin pair in a concentrated price range and earn the trading fees of everyone swapping through it. The deepest DEX there is; the yield is organic fees.
legit: the largest decentralised exchange, live since 2018
v3 ran four years with no core-pool loss of LP funds
fees are paid by traders — no emissions needed to exist
risks: a concentrated position earns nothing while the price sits outside your range — stable pairs drift less, but it still needs tending
paired exposure: if one coin in the pair depegs, part of your dollars become it
v4 is new code (2025) and pools can attach third-party hooks — a hook is someone else's contract in your pool

protocols.name: Pendle
protocols.blurb: Buy a principal token at a discount and hold it to maturity: the discount IS your rate, fixed on the day you enter. The other side (LP / yield tokens) trades the floating rate instead.
legit: pioneered onchain yield tokenization, live since 2021
billions in PT/LP markets with the fixed-rate mechanism working through two full cycles
audited repeatedly and the maturity payoff is enforced by the contract, not a promise
risks: the fixed rate only holds if you stay to maturity — exiting early is a market sale at whatever the implied rate is that day
a PT inherits its underlying's risks: a PT on USDe carries Ethena's basis risk, not just Pendle's contract risk
LP-side APYs are partly PENDLE incentives — the farmed half fades with the token

protocols.name: Convex
protocols.blurb: Deposit Curve stable-LP tokens and Convex boosts the CRV gauge rewards with its pooled veCRV, no lockup on your side.
legit: live since 2021 with the largest veCRV position in existence
billions staked through it without loss of depositor LP tokens
audited (MixBytes) and the base Curve fees underneath are organic
risks: most of the boosted rate is CRV/CVX emissions — it falls when those tokens do
two protocols stacked: a bug in either Curve's pool or Convex's wrapper reaches your deposit
paired exposure of the underlying Curve pool rides through unchanged

protocols.name: Yearn
protocols.blurb: Automated vaults that route your stables across lenders and LPs, harvest and compound for you, and charge a fee on the yield.
legit: the original yield aggregator, live since 2020
v3 vaults are audited and strategies are allowlisted by the DAO
a long public record — including honestly disclosed incidents
risks: a vault stacks strategy risk on top of every protocol the strategy touches
it has eaten exploits before (a 2021 DAI-vault strategy lost $11m) — the record is long partly because incidents are in it
the rate floats with wherever the strategy farms this week

protocols.name: Orca
protocols.blurb: Solana's main concentrated-liquidity DEX: provide a stable pair in a range, earn swap fees at Solana speed and cost.
legit: Solana's reference CLMM since 2021, audited (Kudelski, Neodyme)
survived the full Solana cycle including FTX without protocol loss
fee yield is organic trading volume
risks: concentrated positions need tending — out of range earns nothing
paired exposure: a depeg in the pair is partly yours
everything here also inherits Solana's own history of network halts

protocols.name: Frax
protocols.blurb: Hold the issuer's staked dollar (sfrxUSD) and receive the protocol's own earnings — RWA interest and market operations — as a savings rate.
legit: live since 2020 through every stablecoin stress since
moved from fractional to fully-collateralised by design, in public
the savings rate is paid from real protocol revenue, not emissions
risks: issuer risk: you hold one team's dollar, not a basket — its peg is their balance sheet
governance is concentrated and can retune the savings rate at will
the RWA leg adds custodian and banking-rail risk under the onchain wrapper

protocols.name: Jupiter Lend
protocols.blurb: Solana lending by the Jupiter team on Fluid's licensed engine — deposit dollars, borrowers pay you, withdraw while liquidity lasts.
legit: built by Solana's dominant aggregator team with Fluid's battle-tested design
grew to around a billion dollars of stables within months
audited before launch (Offside, Zenith among others)
risks: months old — the track record is shorter than one bad market
launch-phase rates are partly incentives and points, not all interest
Solana chain risk underneath everything

protocols.name: BlackRock BUIDL
protocols.blurb: BlackRock's tokenized T-bill fund: hold BUIDL and the US bill rate accrues daily. The safest rate in dollars, wrapped for chains — but behind a velvet rope.
legit: issued by the world's largest asset manager through Securitize, a regulated transfer agent
around $3b parked in it — the largest tokenized fund
the yield is US Treasury bills, not a protocol's promise
risks: KYC and qualified-investor gated — this desk cannot put you in; entry is through Securitize
the token is transfer-restricted: liquidity is mint/redeem and whitelisted counterparties, not an open market
the rate is the bill rate — it falls the day the Fed cuts

protocols.name: Ondo
protocols.blurb: Tokenized treasury products (USDY, OUSG): short-duration US government yield passed through to the token, with daily accrual.
legit: over $2b issued with named management and regulated fund structures
backed by T-bills and bank deposits held with institutional custodians
live since 2022 across several chains
risks: gated: KYC always, and USDY is not offered to US persons — this desk cannot put you in
redemptions settle on fund timelines (days), not block time
issuer and custodian risk sit under the onchain wrapper

protocols.name: Circle USYC
protocols.blurb: Circle's tokenized money-market fund (ex-Hashnote): hold USYC, accrue the short-term treasury repo rate, redeem to USDC.
legit: issued by Circle, the USDC issuer, after acquiring Hashnote
billions in it, with near-instant USYC/USDC convertibility for permitted holders
the yield is treasury repo, not a protocol's emissions
risks: institutional KYB gating — mint and redeem are for onboarded firms, not wallets
fund NAV and repo-market risk, tiny but not zero
concentration: issuer, cash leg and redemption rail are all one company

protocols.name: Centrifuge
protocols.blurb: Lend dollars against real-world assets — invoices, treasuries, credit funds — through tranched onchain pools run by named asset managers.
legit: the longest-running RWA credit protocol, pools live since 2021
institutional managers (including Janus Henderson, Anemoy) run named funds on it
tranche structure puts a junior buffer under senior lenders
risks: credit risk is the product: real borrowers can default, and recovery happens offchain in courts
KYC per pool and redemption queues — exits wait for the pool, not the chain
junior tranches absorb losses first — know which tranche you hold

protocols.name: JustLend
protocols.blurb: Tron's main money market — deposit dollars (mostly USDT, which lives on Tron at scale), borrowers pay you.
legit: live since 2020 on the chain that settles most of the world's USDT
consistently among the largest lenders by deposits
simple Compound-style pool design with a long uptime record
risks: the whole stack — chain, lender, listed assets — orbits one founder's ecosystem; that is a single trust decision, not several
USDD exposure in the listings is an algorithmic-history stablecoin
governance and admin keys are concentrated and can move fast

protocols.name: Venus
protocols.blurb: BNB Chain's main money market: deposit dollars into the core pool, borrowers post collateral and pay you.
legit: live since 2020, the largest lender on BNB Chain
isolated-pool redesign and resilient oracle setup after early lessons
multiple audits (OpenZeppelin, Certik, Peckshield among them)
risks: it carries scar tissue: a 2021 price-manipulation event left bad debt the protocol had to absorb
BNB Chain's validator set is small and exchange-adjacent — chain trust is part of the deposit
rates have at times been flattered by XVS emissions

protocols.name: Usual
protocols.blurb: Hold USD0++ — a staked, treasury-backed dollar — and earn the backing's yield plus USUAL emissions on top.
legit: USD0 is fully backed by tokenized treasuries held with named custodians
grew to hundreds of millions quickly with audited contracts
the base yield comes from the T-bill backing, which is real
risks: terms changed under holders once already: the January 2025 USD0++ redemption-floor switch repriced exits overnight
a large share of the quoted rate is USUAL token emissions
young protocol, young token, young governance — all three are untested in a drawdown
